text_block_list.name: PJ Participant Umamusumes
text_block_list.text: Thanks for the food!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Munch, munch...!
Ahh, staff meals are the best!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Man, this is seriously delicious!
You know which mushrooms are edible, you can butcher meat...
Mr. Tucker, were you a chef before?

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: Dahaha! Nah! I just got better at it after living outdoors and cooking for myself for a while!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Living outdoors and cooking your own food...?
So that's how it was.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"Still, why would that happen in the first place...?
...Yeah, there are just too many mysteries."

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: "Hey, Mr. Tucker... Who exactly... are you?"

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Why were you living in the wild?
And why are you developing an uninhabited island?

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
"Who" am I—huh?
I suppose we never did talk about that!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
All right, you got it!
I'll tell you an old story to go with your meal!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
I used to be an instructor for Umamusume
at a mid-sized training facility!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
While learning about cutting-edge technology and facilities,
being impressed by their effects and applying them to training—

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Deep within my heart, there was one idea
that had never faded away!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: Could there still be untapped potential in an Umamusume's instincts...?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Speaking of an Umamusume's instincts—

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: The urge to "win," to "run"...!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
A training facility that stimulates that—
a wilderness facility reconnecting with raw instinct must also have something to offer Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, there is no established theory to back this up.
It is purely my own pet theory!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
However, when I threw myself out into the field
and sprinted across it—

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: At times—I felt an inexplicable instinct!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
The exhilaration of racing through!
The thrill surging from deep within my gut! My pounding heart!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
And so, as if riding a wave, I surrendered mind
and body to instinct and dashed right through...
Clocking a time unbelievable for someone out of practice.

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
That was when I suddenly remembered.
The look on an Umamusume's face rarely seen during critical moments of a race.

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: Could that ecstatic expression and ferocious run have stemmed from this instinctive surge?

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
So that state-of-the-art technology and facilities
can benefit the Umamusume—

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Wouldn't that innate "instinct" she's always possessed
also guide her to even greater heights?!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: "If there were a training facility that stimulates instinct, wouldn't that open up an even brighter future for Umamusume...?!"

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
And, well. Drunk on the moment, I blabbed that story
to an elderly stranger, and then—

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: Turns out that old guy was actually a high-up URA official! Dahaha!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps it struck a chord with him, for he offered his support, telling me to test-develop and build on an uninhabited island!
And that is how we arrived at our current development!

text_block_list.name: PJ Participant Umamusumes
text_block_list.text: Eeeh!?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Wh-What's with this sudden turn of events? I knew you had good connections, but... could something like that really happen?

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: "I couldn't believe it at first either, but... it really existed! Dahaha!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Still, I got a little overexcited! In other words: "Trees grow lush because they reach for the sun"!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: "It was Mr. Tucker's passion that moved his heart, after all!"

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
"No, well... I was just lucky.
I'm merely a trainer who loves watching Umamusume run, possessing no great talent myself."

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Those who earnestly aimed for victory,
those who lost their way and stepped aside,
I've watched all of them, right by their side.

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: How many times has she pushed me forward... and how many times have I cursed my own powerlessness? I've lost count.

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
The stride of an Umamusume is pure light.
They were born to run.
Those words are by no means... an exaggeration.

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: "That is precisely why it is utterly unacceptable for an Umamusume like her to be unable to unleash her true potential."

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Comparing all possibilities, pursuing them, and providing them.
That is the duty of a mentor, and one must never be satisfied with the status quo.

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: That is precisely why I wish to create it—

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: A facility to pioneer the future of all Umamusume with an unprecedented approach.

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
"Because there's no such thing
as an Umamusume 'without talent.'"

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Is Tucker-san—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
When we get down to serious talk,
she's quiet and acts so mature~

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
"...Ha!?
Wait, did I just—"

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
*Ahem*!!
No!! My ears must be playing tricks on me!!
DAHAHAHA!!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Aren't ya way too bad at playin' it off?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"...Well, you must have your reasons.
More importantly, I'm just relieved it wasn't some shady past."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yer right. Mr. Tucker might not look it,
but he's actually pretty darn serious.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Right.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Tucker-san.
Let's make sure this project is an absolute success!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Let's make this a success and create a place that will
carve out a history as long as Tracen Academy's!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Ah, naturally!
Naturally, that's the plan!
